outcomes.note: The MAPS news index and the MAPS ibogaine items to 2026-08-25 carry no statement that the MAPS ibogaine programme for substance use disorders is fully funded through to an FDA decision. The largest ibogaine money in the window is public money outside MAPS: Texas put $50 million into its own IMPACT trials led by UTHealth Houston and UTMB after no drug company met its terms, and the April 2026 federal executive order added $50 million. evidence.title: Lykos Series B Financing First Close Completed
Psychedelic Funding Update: Q2 2025

outcomes.note: Lykos Therapeutics, the sponsor that holds the midomafetamine NDA programme, announced on 2025-05-30 that the first close of its Series B financing was completed: $50 million, co-led by the Gracias Family Foundation and the CH Foundation, recapitalizing the company. That is a completed equity financing closed after 31 October 2024, announced by the sponsor itself. The sponsor press release URL now returns 404 because the company was renamed Resilient Pharmaceuticals in August 2025; Psychedelic Alpha reports the same announcement, date and amount. No Form D exists for Lykos or Resilient in SEC EDGAR, so the company release is the primary record.

evidence.title: Recognify Life Sciences Provides Update on Phase 2b Trial of Inidascamine in Patients with Cognitive Impairment Associated with Schizophrenia
Recognify Life Sciences Provides Update on Phase 2b Trial of Inidascamine in Patients with Cognitive Impairment Associated with Schizophrenia

outcomes.note: Recognify Life Sciences (atai) reported topline results on 2025-07-25. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2b trial of inidascamine (formerly RL-007) in 242 patients with cognitive impairment associated with schizophrenia did not meet its primary endpoint, the MCCB neurocognitive composite score at week 6, with numerical improvement in both active arms. This is the first public report of the primary-endpoint result, not an interim or blinded update, so it fixes the date. The direction of the result does not matter under the criterion.

evidence.title: J&J's blockbuster Spravato is setting the stage for managing psychedelics' risks
Johnson & Johnson Investor Relations (earnings materials and presentations)

outcomes.note: J&J discloses a cumulative patient count, not a 12-month count. CEO Joaquin Duato's figure, more than 200,000 patients treated with Spravato, is cumulative since the 2019 approval. The disclosed series runs 140,000 at the start of 2025, 180,000 at Q3 2025, and more than 200,000 at Q4 2025, which implies roughly 60,000 new patients in a 12-month period, far below the 200,000 threshold. No J&J disclosure reports 200,000 or more patients treated in a 12-month period. The event is not unresolvable: J&J does publish patient counts, they are just cumulative, so realized_value for a 12-month period is null.

evidence.title: Two Years After Rejection, Resilient Quietly Refiles MDMA for PTSD Application
MDMA and the FDA, Take Two
MAPS Responds to Report of Progress for MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD with FDA

outcomes.note: Close call, resolved no. Resilient Pharmaceuticals, the renamed sponsor of the midomafetamine NDA, is reported to have resubmitted the NDA in early August 2026 without a new Phase 3 study, using external data and a new Phase 1 study. But the sponsor has published nothing: reporting notes Resilient has not publicly discussed the resubmission. MAPS, which states it has no active role in Resilient's development programme, said the NDA is being submitted without a new Phase 3 study. The FDA has published no correspondence in Drugs@FDA, and no acceptance or filing decision is public. So no sponsor announcement and no FDA publication of an FDA agreement exists as of 2026-09-14. A sponsor choosing its filing route is not the FDA agreeing to it.

Judgment logged: the 2025-05-20 release reports Part 2 of a Phase 2a trial whose Part 1 topline came in March 2024, outside the window, so that trial is counted once, inside the window.

evidence.title: Drugs@FDA (openFDA drugsfda endpoint) query for midomafetamine, psilocybin, lysergide, ibogaine and mebufotenin: no matches
Two Years After Rejection, Resilient Quietly Refiles MDMA for PTSD Application
Psilocybin FDA Approval Status - Tracker & Timeline

outcomes.note: No psychedelic or entactogen drug product is approved in Drugs@FDA, so no approved labeling or REMS can permit group-format dosing. Drugs@FDA returns no product for midomafetamine, psilocybin, lysergide, ibogaine or mebufotenin as of 2026-09-14. The midomafetamine NDA was resubmitted in August 2026 after the August 2024 complete response letter and has no approval. COMP360 psilocybin holds a national priority voucher and is completing a rolling NDA targeted at Q4 2026, with any decision expected later. A resubmission, a voucher or a filing does not count under the criterion.
